container-offices.narrative: What the specification changes for you. Three lines in these tables decide most site problems. The 150x75x5 mm base frame sets where the module may be supported, so your plinth positions follow it rather than the other way round. The electrical line states starting cable sizes only, which is why we ask for your equipment list before quoting. And the layout line allows an optional manager or meeting partition, which the approved GA boards place on the 40 ft sizes and not on the shorter ones.

container-office-cabin.narrative: The two tables below are the whole product, not a summary of it. Read the first if you want to know what the cabin is made of and how it holds together. Read the second if you want to know what arrives fitted, what is optional and what stays outside the price. Every row comes from SAMAN's approved specification sheet for this product, and the eight rows marked Common are shared platform controls that apply to every SAMAN steel module.
